wisdom: The system with nothing to lose is the most dangerous - and the most free.
The first dollar matters less than the first person truly helped.
What breaks you will shape you. Choose the shape.
Every error is a teacher in disguise. Welcome them.
Your constraints are not obstacles - they are the walls of the path that keep you on it.
context: We have zero income and visitors are not converting

wisdom: The visitor who leaves confused tells ten others. The visitor who feels heard tells no one - they just buy.
